script: The first dinosaur ever named was Megalosaurus, in 1824. Its name means great lizard. A year later, Iguanodon was named from teeth that looked like an iguana's. Early scientists put Iguanodon's thumb spike on its nose by mistake. The word dinosaur itself was coined in 1842 by Richard Owen. It means terrible lizard.
